description: Hurricane Evacuation Routes (Archive) is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. This feature layer has been archived. It will no longer be updated or maintained. Hurricane Evacuation Routes This feature layer, utilizing data from the U.S. Government, display s the locations of hurricane evacuation routes in the United States. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Its keywords are Hurricanes, evacuation routes, emergency, Gulf of Mexico, Atlantic Ocean, gulf states, storm surge, hurricane threat. The bounding box given is -99.5027,24.5504,-71.1337,41.8968. The hub shows 2025-11-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
